text.arabic: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ أَلَمْ تَرَ كَيْفَ فَعَلَ رَبُّكَ بِأَصْحَٰبِ ٱلْفِيلِ

translations.asad: ART THOU NOT aware of how thy Sustainer dealt with the Army of the Elephant?
translations.sahih: Have you not considered, [O Muhammad], how your Lord dealt with the companions of the elephant?

translations.asad: Did He not utterly confound their artful planning?
translations.sahih: Did He not make their plan into misguidance?

translations.asad: Thus, He let loose upon them great swarms of flying creatures
translations.sahih: And He sent against them birds in flocks,

translations.asad: which smote them with stone-hard blows of chastisement pre-ordained,
translations.sahih: Striking them with stones of hard clay,

translations.asad: and caused them to become like a field of grain that has been eaten down to stubble
translations.sahih: And He made them like eaten straw.
